verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Managed Slurm, which 'automatically schedules workloads', and head nodes used for 'job scheduling'. That is queue and resource scheduling of submitted jobs, not a recurring, time-based schedule. No documented cron-style or recurring job or workflow capability appears in the pack, and the MK8s and Cloud API evidence describes only one-off provisioning and deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
